string.text: Colonel Kuznetsov has summoned me to HQ for new orders.
The colonel has transferred me to the infantry. I need to collect my gear from the quartermaster at the warehouse.
Go down into the underground and check on the squad
First assignment: go down into the tunnels under the base, check on the garrison and help them if needed.
Go down into the underground and check on the squad
The commander of the underground squad asked me to examine his men and help them however I can.
Find the soldier's body and kill the mutant
The creature that dragged a soldier into the northern part of the underground is still there.
Find the pistol in the tunnel with the electros and return it to the soldier
A soldier dropped his award pistol in a tunnel that is now full of anomalies.
Find out what was bothering the soldier
Check the northern part of the underground
The soldier heard singing from the northern part of the underground, and then screams and gunfire.
Go up to the surface and report to the colonel
My business in the underground is done, time to go up.
Collect the crates from the quartermaster
The colonel ordered me to collect three supply crates for the checkpoints and a special case for Seriy from the quartermaster.
The quartermaster has arranged a "deal" with the bandits and will get in touch when they're in place.
Deliver the crates to the checkpoints
Three supply crates need to be delivered to the garrison checkpoints.
Go to the meeting point and deal with the bandits
The bandits have arrived at the meeting place. I need to kill them all and take the ammo.
The colonel's case has to be handed over to Seriy, the head of the stalkers at the factory.
Seriy's scouts are coming back from Yantar with important information about the unknown stalkers. I need to meet them and escort them to the camp.
The dead scouts were from Fanatic's group. Seriy asks me to question him: maybe he noticed something strange in how they behaved.
Fanatic's group left a cache on the upper level of the underground, not far from the anomalous tunnel. Fanatic promised to split the contents fifty-fifty.
West of the stalker complex, the signal of the colonel's scout went dead. I need to find him and take the PDA with important information.
The scout is dead, his PDA is destroyed. I need to report what happened to the colonel.
The colonel said the quartermaster was looking for me.
Lay a zombie's soul to rest
Kill the zombie with the unique machine gun
Return the machine gun to the quartermaster

The quartermaster's little brother went missing with his patrol a week ago. If he's among the zombies, he'll have a heavy machine gun. I need to lay him to rest and bring the machine gun back to his brother.
The quartermaster's brother was among the zombies. There's no helping him anymore, but at least I can take his machine gun to the quartermaster.
Help the patrols fight off the attacks
Several garrison patrols requested help at the same time: they've been attacked by zombies.
The patrols fought them off. Time to go back to Seriy: he promised to tell me more about the Order.
Get the devices from the stalker radio operator
Seriy asked me to get three PVM-14 devices from the radio operator and come back to him.
Seriy's radio operator is dead, the PVM-14 devices are gone. Seriy is sure this is the Order's doing and that the killer is still somewhere in Agroprom. I need to find him and get the devices back.
Meet up with the assault group

Colonel Kuznetsov found out where the zombies are coming from: they've taken the fortified point by the road to Yantar. Captain Akeran's squad is leading the sweep. I need to join him and destroy the lair.
Captain Akeran ordered us to search the bodies. Among the dead was a shepherd in a robe. If anyone has something important, it's him.
Eliminate the soldiers from the northern checkpoint
The missing soldiers from the northern checkpoint came back and opened fire on their own. Captain Akeran is dead. They have to be stopped.
The colonel ordered me back to base. I need to report everything that happened by the road to Yantar.
Kuznetsov is pulling all forces to the main base. I need to convince Seriy to pack up the camp and bring the stalkers to the military.
Install the device on the roof
Seriy's camp has been attacked by wild cultists. The stalkers are holding the line, and I need to get up on the roof, install the first device on the antenna and hold out until it starts up.
Install the device in the forest
Seriy's stalkers who were preparing the second tower in the forest are being attacked by mutants. I need to come to their aid, install the second device and hold the position until it starts up.
Install the device at the trailer in the swamp
Two towers are working. The third one is left: the antenna on the trailer in the middle of the swamp. I need to get there, install the last device and return to Seriy.
I told Horus "yes". Someone is waiting for me not far from the trailer, toward the base.
Fulgrim gave me the Order's gear. Together with his fighters I must take the base. Not one of them may leave alive. The colonel is mine personally.
Find Seriy at the stalker camp
what are you staring at, the electronics were dead
Get to checkpoint 3, by the passage to the Garbage
Get to checkpoint 2, east of the forest
we're competing for a png picture on a website....
Comms are back. Colonel Kuznetsov has declared a combat alert: all soldiers return to base immediately, defense per plan "Fortress".
Someone blew up our fuel depot. There are wounded with burns in the infirmary, the duty officer is urgently calling for me.
Find the traitors on the base
Find and deal with the traitors

Before the explosion, some of our own were hanging around the fuel tanks, most likely traitors. I need to find them before they commit another act of sabotage. They're still somewhere on the base, and something must set them apart from the others. Their PDA profile, maybe?
The colonel is waiting for my report in his office.
The colonel is sending me down for the last part of the maps. The quartermaster will give me the best gear left on the base.
Go down into the Agroprom underground
I need to go down into the underground, find the sergeant and go to P-2 with the underground garrison for the last part of the maps.
The Order has attacked the underground garrison, and there were traitors among our own. I need to fight off the attack while there's still someone left of the garrison.
Seriy and his stalkers went down to P-2. The last part of the maps is somewhere there. I have to hurry.

PDA of the underground garrison sergeant. Last entry:\n\n"Didn't expect a setup like this... To die at the hands of my own. The private's an idiot. Told him a hundred times to hand all the grenades over to me, so we don't blow anything up down here, God forbid. He didn't listen... Now I'm lying here bleeding out, and my men are dying at the hands of traitors and... I don't even know who else. Heh, maybe I imagined it... But I saw some stalkers walk right past the fight. Not shooting, not hiding, just walked past. One in front, so calm, and then down below... I must be delirious already... Looks like I won't last long, this is the end..."
Seriy went down to P-2 for the last part of the maps. If he made it, he should have the maps on him.
Fanatic, the one who gunned down his own group in the tunnel, has come for the maps. He won't leave here alive.
The Order has started the assault. The base, the colonel, the guys... I need to get up there as fast as possible. The exit is at the other end of the tunnel.
The last part of the archive maps from P-2. Too many people died for these sheets of paper.
The Order has started the assault. Zombies are climbing into the base from all sides.
The technicians are trying to fix the helicopter: there's enough fuel for one flight. We have to hold out as long as we can.
Destroy the wild ones at the north entrance
The north entrance is being breached. By something that used to be human.
The Order's main force is coming from the northeast. Our sniper is down, his spot on the roof is mine now.
The sergeant who was taking the maps from the colonel's office was taken out by a sniper on the hill. I need to eliminate the snipers and get the documents.
The colonel ordered me to leave. Through the hole in the south wall, to the hatch, and from there through the underground tunnel to the Cordon. The maps must not fall into the Order's hands.
Area maps from Colonel Kuznetsov's desk, all the parts collected over the past weeks. Among them is the one once taken from the digger's body.
Find out what happened to Ghost
Help Mole fight off the soldiers
Help the stalkers fight off the soldiers
Help the stalkers fight off the soldiers
Find information about Strelok in the stash
Find the way out of the underground
Take the documents to the Barkeep
